change: verify-dist-fresh now resolves its own pinned build toolchain (declared follow-up, closed)
problem: the gate byte-compares every dist against a rebuild, and those bytes are only reproducible under the PINNED bun. The pin lives in package.json buildToolchain, but nothing made the two meet: the honest way to run the gate was to export PATH="$PWD/.toolchain/node_modules/.bin:$PATH" first. Measured cost of forgetting: one full wave reported 23/23 STALE plus failures in two other packages' F1 arms, because bun 1.3.x and 1.4.x emit a different injected helper preamble.
fix: resolveBuildBin(root) runs ONCE per run, before anything builds: a .toolchain/node_modules/.bin/bun that REPORTS the pinned version wins; anything else falls back to PATH and the report SAYS which was used. A local bun that disagrees with the pin is NOT preferred, because preferring it would certify the bytes under the wrong bun.

proof.unprefixed_run: with bun 1.3.14 first on PATH (the wrong one) and NO export line, the gate reports 23/23 FRESH and prints: FRESH   packages/mpd-better-sidebar-host/dist/index.js  sha d6a787c4a59a… 18ms  <- packages/mpd-better-sidebar-host/src/index.ts
proof.self_test: 17/17 arms, including two NEW ones for the resolver: (h4) a local toolchain that AGREES with the pin is preferred over PATH; (h5) one that DISAGREES falls back to PATH and says so.
proof.regression_guard: the existing 15 arms still pass, so the gate still reddens on a seeded mismatch

not_claimed: the toolchain is still INSTALLED by whatever put it there; the gate resolves it, it does not fetch it. A tree with no .toolchain still runs on PATH and says so.
